description:
Quran Vision Corpus (v6.2.2) is an open-access bilingual (Turkish / English) academic corpus and interactive foresight cockpit featuring 15 foundational Quranic verse reports (QV-2026-001 to QV-2026-015) and 33 A4 PDF documents. Every monograph integrates 77 primary classical Arabic tafsir citations (ISNAD 2nd Edition verified with 100% verbatim Shamela text and exact page_id links), unified 3-part Step 13 Irfani/Sufi Hermeneutics (al-Qushayri, al-Ghazali, al-Muhasibi, Sahl al-Tustari, Ibn 'Ajibah), 45 contemporary empirical datasets (APA 7 / DOI: World Bank, UNDP, WJP, UNESCO, SIPRI, OECD, WHO), 10-year Bayesian policy simulations (2026–2036), falsifiable early-warning thresholds, and 40-minute competency-based seminar/classroom debate lesson plans.

Release Notes (v6.2.2): v6.2.2: Complete Irfani/Sufi Hermeneutics Reform across 15 monographs (Step 13), 100% verbatim classical Arabic quotes with exact page_id Shamela links, comprehensive Hadith/Ayat/Ulama tahrij in body text, addition of 33rd document (ISNAD-2 Classical Arabic Databases Guide authored by Mehmet Yarıcı), and compiled master corpus books.
